book_intro: The calendar below reflects current availability. Dates are held only once a booking request has been confirmed in writing.
book_side_text: Every rental to date has begun with a call or a text. Inquiries reach the owner directly and are answered in person rather than routed through a form.
rule_driver: Every driver must be 25 or older, named on the rental agreement, and bring a current valid driver's licence to the handoff. No CDL is needed.
rule_insurance: Insurance is included and charged at $49 a day — a $500,000 policy. On a claim you cover the deductible, up to $1,000. You keep your own AAA roadside cover.
rule_smoking: No smoking or vaping inside at any time. No roof access and no climbing the ladder.
rule_pets: Dogs welcome, limit two, $125. That covers cleaning only — damage is separate. No cats.
rule_generator: 4 generator hours a day are included, then $4 an hour. Campground quiet hours, usually 10pm to 7am, still apply.
rule_return: Back at the agreed time, emptied of your belongings and trash. A late return is $200. Fuel, propane, extra miles and generator hours are settled then.
